scope: Province-wide estimated dry-season habitat decoration, not surveyed animals

pilot.habitat: harvested rice stubble; estimated managed subgroup

rules.seedling: Loose 2-15 egret/pond-heron group; authored .02<stage<.14; permanent water<.35; crop>220/255; denser within160m of existing OSM canals. Density estimated, not census.
rules.bank: Canal cross-sections 180-260m plus/minus35m jitter; main-river cross-sections450m;115m duplicate exclusion and mask/clearance gaps. Rendered-water .5 contour, buildings/roads excluded. Kingfishers on about half eligible small-canal banks. Density estimated.
rules.sky: Few 5-30 egret lines/Vs, 30-80m up, toward existing dense tree-map patch; inferred destinations, not surveyed roosts.
rules.angler: Foot .35m dry side of bilinear water=.5 contour; waterX/North target 2.1m wet side.
rules.snail: Pila native and Pomacea invasive; sparse canal-edge own posts and shallow seedling paddy. Pink eggs only Pomacea.

sources: Existing modified Copernicus Sentinel-2 / ESA WorldCover masks and tree maps
